technical_and_design_decisions: Implement all new functions in Go, adhering to existing Hyperledger Fabric code patterns and conventions in the configtx package.
For U6, create a separate function for system channel genesis block generation to maintain modularity and clarity, avoiding combination with application channel creation.

For U8, rename CreateSignedConfigUpdateEnvelope to SignConfigUpdateEnvelope for improved API usability, and extend the SigningIdentity interface to include both SignConfigUpdate and the renamed SignConfigUpdateEnvelope methods, with proper documentation of differences.
Ensure backward compatibility where feasible; for U8, introduce deprecation warnings or versioning if breaking changes are necessary.
Follow test-driven development practices, writing unit tests alongside implementation to meet acceptance criteria.
assumptions: The developer has intermediate to advanced experience with Go programming and familiarity with the Hyperledger Fabric codebase, particularly the configtx package.
The development environment includes necessary tools for Go development, testing, and documentation generation, such as go test and godoc.
No significant changes to external dependencies or underlying infrastructure are required; all work is focused on the configtx package.
Time estimates are for a single developer working independently, without accounting for external reviews or delays beyond the activities listed.
Examples and documentation will be written in English and follow the existing style in the Hyperledger Fabric repository.
All user stories are implemented sequentially as listed, with activities covering code, tests, examples, and documentation updates as per acceptance criteria.

activities.activity_description: Implement functions to add, remove, and retrieve policies in the channel group. Update existing examples to demonstrate usage of these features.

Implement a function for removing a specific consortium from a channel config. Update examples to demonstrate usage.

activities.activity_description: Implement a function to create genesis blocks for system channels, which does not include an application group. Add a new example demonstrating this behavior.
Write and add an Overview section in the GoDocs for the configtx package, explaining its purpose, usage, and channel structure.

Rename CreateSignedConfigUpdateEnvelope to SignConfigUpdateEnvelope and extend the SigningIdentity interface to include SignConfigUpdate method. Update GoDoc documentation to explain usage and differences.
Add or update examples for U2, U3, U4, U5, and U6 as per their acceptance criteria, ensuring they are included in example_test or new test files.

Review all implemented code for consistency, performance, and adherence to standards. Integrate changes with the main codebase and resolve any conflicts.
